title: GTCO Dyson-Sphere Selection Calibration: RASTI transfer reproduction package
description: Reproducibility package accompanying the RASTI-transfer manuscript on selection-function calibration for Gaia DR3-2MASS-AllWISE partial-Dyson searches. The numerical analysis is unchanged from the frozen v1.0.0-submission snapshot; this version updates manuscript framing, journal metadata, accessibility text, and submission documentation.
notes: Prepared for transfer to RAS Techniques and Instruments after MNRAS MN-26-2504-P was declined for scope. No new numerical analysis is introduced relative to the frozen v1.0.0-submission analysis release.
